findings: Stage 2 presentation does not ground the scored learner-self identity before it is required: no modeled turn identifies Ninereeds with "I'm Ninereeds." or demonstrates "Yes, I'm Ninereeds.", while presentation-negative already uses the name Ninereeds without displaying or previously naming Ninereeds and every controlled gate then assumes the learner can transfer other speakers' I/you roles to itself. Repair Stage 2 with an explicit full-scene, speaker-attributed Ninereeds self-identification and affirmative learner-role model before any scored learner-self use, then regenerate the dependent gate artifacts and exact assembly.

Stage 2 introduces meeting reciprocity out of its isolated gate: presentation-affirmative, presentation-negative, presentation-W-question, and presentation-OR-question each contain "Nice to meet you" / "Nice to meet you, too" before presentation-reciprocity. This violates the required original gated order and hides the Stage 6A operation inside earlier presentation blocks. Repair Stage 2 so each early block models only its own operation and introduce reciprocity only in its dedicated post-OR presentation/gate before mixed practice.

Stage 13 binds a nonexistent pixel-review byte identity. Every visual-plan receipt_sha256 and embedded verification receipt_sha256 is e6963f1fea653f6970d88cff75a765906c64f09bd5b2350b8c1fbc0920a3969c, but the supplied anonymous-pixel-review.json hashes to 9c72719eb3a6b820890ab6486a8f665b58fd9d148a3a60449f98abbcbd2cfa7a. The exact assets themselves match their declared hashes and need no crops, but the stale receipt binding makes the accepted visual evidence non-immutable. Repair the owning receipt/source binding and reassemble; do not treat the embedded copied verdict as a substitute for the hash-bound receipt.

Stage 13 exposes PRESENT_AGAIN and FINISH in controller_actions without executable definitions, eligibility conditions, exact replay/termination behavior, or bounded stop rules; presentation_replay_after_failures is only an integer and does not resolve what PRESENT_AGAIN executes. In addition, mixed_practice contains 20 base items while mixed_practice_cap is 16, so the declared fixed pool cannot all execute under the cap and the completion denominator/order is unspecified. Repair Stage 13 with fully resolved PRESENT_AGAIN and FINISH actions, an explicit mixed execution order and denominator, and mutually consistent caps and completion rules; retain only frozen IDs and no live freestyle.
